name: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure
description: Connect your own Oracle Cloud Infrastructure tenancy (API signing key, OCI Request Signing RSA-SHA256) to see and manage Compute instances, Object Storage buckets/objects, Autonomous Database systems, IAM users/groups, Monitoring alarms, and Usage/Cost reports from Imperal. Your API key is verified against your tenancy before it's saved. Scoped to the operational core -- OKE, Data Science/GenAI and Oracle Analytics Cloud are out of scope.

tools.name: connect_oci
tools.description: Connect your own Oracle Cloud Infrastructure tenancy by saving an API signing key (tenancy OCID + user OCID + fingerprint + private key) plus your home region, after checking it actually works via a harmless Identity read. A Read-only IAM policy is strongly recommended for the user you create.

tenancy_ocid.description: Your OCI tenancy OCID, e.g. ocid1.tenancy.oc1..aaaa...
tenancy_ocid.title: Tenancy Ocid

user_ocid.description: Your OCI user OCID, e.g. ocid1.user.oc1..aaaa...
user_ocid.title: User Ocid

fingerprint.description: The fingerprint of your API signing key, e.g. aa:bb:cc:dd:...
fingerprint.title: Fingerprint

private_key.description: The PEM contents of your API signing key's private key.
private_key.title: Private Key

compartment_ocid.description: Optional compartment to scope reads to; leave empty to use the tenancy root compartment.
compartment_ocid.title: Compartment Ocid

label.description: Optional friendly name for this OCI tenancy connection.
label.title: Label

tools.name: disconnect_oci
tools.description: Disconnect an OCI tenancy: deletes the saved API signing key. Nothing in OCI itself is changed.

connection_id.description: The connection id to disconnect, from list_connections.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

secrets.name: oci_connections
secrets.description: Your connected OCI tenancies -- stored as a JSON array, one entry per tenancy, each with its own tenancy_ocid, user_ocid, fingerprint, private_key (PEM), region, compartment_ocid and a friendly label. Managed through connect_oci / disconnect_oci -- you should not need to edit this directly.
